title: Chapter 417 - 417 Getting Master Chef Experience

Chapter 417 - 417 Getting Master Chef Experience

Chapter 417 - 417 Getting Master Chef Experience

417 Getting Master Chef Experience

Lin Fan looked at the email on the screen and was slightly stunned.

He seemed to have thought of something and quickly opened the next email.

It was sent by Xia Xue.

Lin Fan could not help but laugh and say, “These two ladies want to be my students?”

“I haven’t been spending much time with them. After becoming my students, I can spend more time with them.”

As Lin Fan spoke, he ticked Xia Bing’s and Xia Xue’s names.

Then, he clicked on the next email.

Very quickly, he finished reading all 50 emails.

Originally, Lin Fan had planned to choose one person from each field—mathematics, computer science, physics, chemistry, and biology.

However, Xia Bing and Xia Xue were both computer science students.

In the end, the number of students Lin Fan chose increased from five to six.

To Lin Fan, choosing a student was just a small matter.

After replying to six emails, he went to sleep quietly.

He slept quietly… but many people could not sleep tonight!

In the female dormitory of Jiangbei University…

Xia Bing and Xia Xue stared at the mailbox interface whenever they were free.

Today was no exception.

After dinner, they turned on their laptops and stared at their laptop screens without blinking. Their beautiful faces were filled with anticipation and nervousness.

At this moment, the laptops let out a soft sound.

They both received an email.

In the next moment…

Xia Bing’s and Xia Xue’s pretty faces were like blooming flowers, extremely brilliant.

There were only four words in the email—Congratulations, you’ve been accepted!

Even so, Xia Bing and Xia Xue read it and forth a dozen times.

In the end, the two women who had always been docile jumped up happily.

…

In the male dormitory of Capital University.

Hao Zhiwu, who was wearing black-rimmed glasses and had a kitten on his shoulder, was very focused on playing a game called Pesticide.

“Three, two, one! My big move is ready!”

“One!

“Two!

“Three!

“Harvest them all!”

He controlled the hero and wiped out one enemy after another like flowing water.

Soon, he broke through the enemy’s crystal and obtained the final victory!

Some people had good grades and were also good at games, which was more infuriating.

“We won!” Hao Zhiwu shouted excitedly.

“Hao Zhiwu, don’t be so agitated. It’s just a game.”

“Alright,” Hao Zhiwu replied casually.

At this moment, Hao Zhiwu’s phone vibrated slightly, and an email popped up.

He clicked to check.

The next moment, Hao Zhiwu shouted again, “That’s great!”

“Hao Zhiwu, keep your voice down!” his roommate complained again.

However…

This time, Hao Zhiwu laughed as if he did not hear anything.

“Great, this is great. Hahaha!”

This was because there were four words in the email—’Congratulations, you’ve been accepted!’

He was accepted!

He had been recruited by God Lin Fan!

…

The internet was also in an uproar.

After Lin Fan had chosen his students, the official website of Jiangbei University also released an announcement.

Jiangbei University: [After a few days of careful consideration, Lin Fan has selected six students. They are Xia Xue and Xia Bing from Jiangbei University, Nie Zhenjiang from Huaqing University, Hao Zhiwu from Capital University, Jiang Chaoqun from Modu University, and Liu Qianqian from Xia Ke University. He looks forward to having them learn under him. In addition, the application channel will be temporarily closed.]

Soon, a large number of comments came in.

Half-Life Snow: [God Lin Fan has already chosen six students? I haven’t even sent my email yet!]

Leng Shang: [Me too! I was even prepared to send it tomorrow!]

Awesome: [Unfortunately, I’m not the one who will accompany God Lin to the end.]

Stone Golem: [Commenter above, I nearly vomited.]

Happy, Happy: [Jiang Chaoqun has been selected! F*ck! I should hurry up and hug his thigh! That’s my former roommate.]

Gentle Water: [Liu Qianqian from Xia Ke University. Does she need a younger sister?]

JK: [Are they all local students? Are they no US students?]

MAKE: [There’s no one from Eagle Country either. This is unfair!]

Mr. Huang: [What fairness? God Lin Fan is from Hua Nation. He can choose whichever student he wants!]

Li Jinyi: [Don’t be so quick to speculate. Our Stick Nation has already verified Lin Fan’s identity. There’s a high possibility that he’s one of our Stick Nation people.]

Entering: [Stick Nation, I’m willing to call you the most shameless!]

…

When a ray of warm sunlight fell on the windowsill, Lin Fan opened his eyes slowly.

He first looked at his phone.

[Notice from Merchant Bank: 7,543,900 yuan was deposited into your account.]

Then, he turned his attention to the check-in system.

“Check-in!”

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve obtained Master Chef Experience. It’s a cooking technique that far exceeds ordinary people’s, and at the same time, it can display a fascinating charm.]

Seeing this…

Lin Fan’s expression changed.

Finally, it was not something as useless as ten million yuan!

Master Chef Experience?

In the past, Lin Fan also wanted to become an outstanding chef.

Later, he also tried to cook for himself.

However, it could only be said that his cooking would not kill people.

After that, he rarely cooked again.

Master Chef Experience… This seemed to be a good thing.

At the same time, Lin Fan’s mind was suddenly filled with many exquisite cooking methods.

It was as if Lin Fan had just received a new toy. He could not wait to get the fresh food store to send over M9 snowflake beef, Australian lobster, egg noodles, potatoes, lettuce, green peppers, eggs, flatbread, garlic, and other ingredients.

Lin Fan brought the ingredients to the kitchen.

Lin Fan picked up a potato and gripped the knife handle tightly.

A crisp and rhythmic sound immediately rang out.

Then, strips of potato that were uniform in size and thickness appeared on the cutting board.

After a wave of smoke rose, a rich fragrance wafted out.

Then…

Delicious dishes were served on the table one after another—perfectly seared snowflake steak, fragrant noodles, golden shredded potatoes, homemade tea eggs, and so on.

Lin Fan picked up the seafood and put it in his mouth. He nodded and said, “The noodles are chewy, and the soup is fragrant. The taste is not bad!”

One had to know…

For the past few months, he had eaten breakfast at a two-star Michelin restaurant almost every day.

Saying the food he cooked was ‘not bad’ was already high praise!

One could imagine how good the taste was.

Lin Fan picked up another piece of snowflake steak and chewed it gently. “The heat is moderate, and the meat melts in the mouth. It maintains the original sweetness of the beef.”

As he ate, he commented on each dish.

After a while, all the food on the table was eaten clean.

Lin Fan rubbed his round tummy, a satisfied look on his face.
